comments.headline: Missing building elevation sheets and clearance documentation
comments.summary: Building elevation sheets required to verify clearances from buildings and projections to overhead electric conductors are entirely absent from the 39-sheet site plan submittal. No clearance dimensions for required 7'6" sky-to-ground clearance or 15-foot radial clearance are documented.
comments.crossDep: Coordinate with Architecture for building elevation sheets; coordinate with Civil Engineering if grade changes affect clearances.
comments.attn: Building elevation sheets are required deliverables and must be submitted with dimension annotations from buildings and projections to OHE conductors before clearance verification can be assessed.

details.text: Building clearances from overhead electric conductors cannot be verified. No horizontal clearance dimensions from conductor to building faces provided, and no elevation sheets document required 7-foot 6-inch sky-to-ground clearance.

runComments.comment: Building clearances from overhead electric conductors cannot be verified. While OHE lines are shown on the site plan along property boundaries where buildings are proposed, no horizontal clearance dimensions are provided from the outside conductors to any building faces. No building elevation sheets are included in the submittal to demonstrate compliance with the required 7-foot 6-inch sky-to-ground clearance.

details.text: Customer facilities (buildings) do not demonstrate compliance with 15-foot radial clearance from outside conductor of overhead distribution conductors. No clearance dimension annotations provided on site plan or in building elevation documentation.

runComments.comment: Customer facilities (buildings) do not demonstrate compliance with 15-foot radial clearance from outside conductor of overhead distribution conductors. No clearance dimension annotations are provided on site plan or in building elevation documentation.

details.text: Building projections (overhangs, awnings, balconies, roofs) are not documented with clearance verification. No building elevation sheets provided in submittal to show spatial relationship between projections and overhead electric conductors.

runComments.comment: Building projections (overhangs, awnings, balconies, roofs) are not documented with clearance verification. No building elevation sheets are provided in the submittal to show the spatial relationship between any building projections and overhead electric conductors.

details.text: Buildings proposed adjacent to Valley View Road (west property line) where overhead electric lines exist in right-of-way. Clearances from buildings to ROW-located overhead facilities not documented with dimension annotations or elevation data.

runComments.comment: Buildings are proposed adjacent to Valley View Road (west property line) where overhead electric lines exist in the right-of-way per the existing conditions survey. Clearances from buildings to the ROW-located overhead facilities are not documented with dimension annotations or elevation data.

details.text: No building elevation sheets included in site plan submittal. Surveyed elevations and locations of overhead electric conductors cannot be verified because building elevation sheets, which typically document this information, are absent from 39-sheet set.

comments.headline: Missing clearance dimension annotations and surveyor verification data
comments.summary: Horizontal and vertical clearance dimension annotations are completely absent from all site plans. Clearance measurements are not taken from the outside conductor as required by code, and no registered surveyor data documents pole locations or mid-span clearances.
comments.crossDep: Coordinate with Surveying profession for registered surveyor data on pole locations, mid-span clearances, and conductor elevations.
comments.attn: UCM § 1.10.3 requires all clearance measurements taken from the outside conductor, not from pole centerlines or structures. Provide dimension annotations originating from conductor location on all relevant plans (site, grading, architectural sections). Surveyor certification required for pole locations and clearance verification.

details.text: Section and plan view exhibits showing clearance dimensions from outer electric conductor to outermost edges of buildings are not provided. Site plan shows OHE lines and building layouts but contains no dimension annotations measuring clearances from conductor to any building face or projection.

runComments.comment: Section and plan view exhibits showing clearance dimensions from outer electric conductor to outermost edges of buildings are not provided. The site plan shows OHE lines and building layouts but contains no dimension annotations measuring clearances from the conductor to any building face or projection.

details.text: No clearance dimension annotations provided on site plans. Critically, OHE lines are marked but no dimension lines originate from outside conductor location. Code requires measurements from conductor, not pole centerlines. Complete absence of clearance dimensions prevents assessment of whether any existing dimensions comply correctly.

runComments.comment: No clearance dimension annotations are provided on the site plans. Critically, the OHE lines are marked but no dimension lines originate from the outside conductor location. The code requirement mandates that all clearance measurements be taken from the outside conductor, not from utility pole centerlines or structures. The complete absence of clearance dimensions prevents assessment of whether any dimensions that might exist are measured correctly.

details.text: Surveyed elevations and locations of overhead electric conductors cannot be verified because building elevation sheets are absent. No survey data from registered surveyor showing pole locations and mid-span clearances provided to establish vertical clearance compliance for buildings and driveways.

runComments.comment: Proposed site features (buildings and driveways) are located in proximity to the OHE line. Without documented conductor elevations and site feature elevations with comparison analysis, vertical clearance compliance appears marginal or unverifiable. No survey data from a registered surveyor showing pole locations and mid-span clearances is provided.

comments.headline: Missing vertical clearance documentation for driveways and retaining walls
comments.summary: Driveways and retaining walls lack vertical clearance documentation from overhead electric lines. Section views and elevation data showing clearances at all points (especially mid-span for driveways) and between wall faces and OHE conductors are missing.
comments.crossDep: Coordinate with Civil Engineering (driveways and grading) and Structural Engineering (retaining walls) for elevation documentation and clearance verification.
comments.attn: Driveway sections must show lowest point of OHE line including attachments and compare to finished driveway grade at all points, especially mid-span. Retaining wall sections must include OHE conductor elevations and clearance dimension annotations from outer conductor to wall faces.

details.text: Retaining walls proposed and shown on site plan and wall detail sheets. Clearance distances from outermost edge of retaining walls to outside conductor of overhead electric line not documented with dimension annotations on plan sheets.

runComments.comment: Retaining walls are proposed and shown on site plan and wall detail sheets. However, clearance distances from the outermost edge of retaining walls to the outside conductor of the overhead electric line are not documented with dimension annotations. The wall plan sheets provide structural details but no clearance dimensions from the OHE line.

details.text: Section exhibits for retaining walls provided (Sheets 38–39) but do not include overhead electric conductor elevations or clearance dimension annotations from outer conductor to wall faces. Sections show structural design but not clearance verification.

runComments.comment: Section exhibits for retaining walls are provided (Sheets 38-39), but these sections do not include overhead electric conductor elevations or clearance dimension annotations from the outer conductor to the wall faces. The sections show structural design but not clearance verification.

details.text: Driveways proposed and shown on site plan and grading plan. Vertical clearances from lowest point of overhead electric line including attachments to finished driveway grade not documented. No section views show mid-span clearance verification for driveways under OHE line.

runComments.comment: Driveways are proposed and shown on site plan and grading plan. However, vertical clearances from the lowest point of the overhead electric line (including any attachments) to the finished driveway grade are not documented. No section views show mid-span clearance verification for driveways under the OHE line.

comments.headline: Boundary and perimeter feature clearances not verified
comments.summary: Fences, sidewalks, streetlight pole setbacks, and down guy wire locations and easements lack clearance documentation and proximity verification. No dimension annotations confirm alignments relative to overhead electric conductors, poles, or property limits.
comments.crossDep: Coordinate with Public Works (sidewalks, streetlight poles on Valley View Road); coordinate with Utility company (existing pole locations, down guy wire infrastructure, relocation or retention decisions).
comments.attn: Existing utility poles shown on existing conditions survey (Sheet 4) but specific locations not integrated into site plan. Clarify whether existing poles will be relocated, remain in place, or be converted to self-supporting. Document down guy wire locations, anchor points, and easement boundaries if poles remain.

details.text: Fence alignments and clearance distances from overhead electric conductors cannot be verified. While site plan includes 'Fence Note' regarding hand-digging in Critical Root Zones, no clearance dimensions shown between fence alignments and conductor positions.

runComments.comment: Fence alignments and clearance distances from overhead electric conductors cannot be verified. While the site plan includes a 'Fence Note' regarding hand-digging requirements in Critical Root Zones, no clearance dimensions are shown between fence alignments and overhead electric conductor positions.

details.text: Sidewalks proposed along property frontage on site plan. Existing power poles present along Valley View Road per existing conditions survey. Alignments of proposed sidewalks relative to existing pole locations at property limits not documented with dimension annotations.

runComments.comment: Sidewalks are proposed along the property frontage (shown on site plan). Existing power poles are present along Valley View Road (west property line) per the existing conditions survey. However, the specific alignments of proposed sidewalks relative to the existing pole locations at property limits are not documented with dimension annotations or detailed clearance verifications.

details.text: Existing streetlight poles likely present along Valley View Road per existing conditions survey showing utility poles along road frontage. Clearances from proposed buildings to existing streetlight pole locations not documented with dimension annotations or setback verification.

runComments.comment: Existing streetlight poles are likely present along Valley View Road per the existing conditions survey, which shows utility poles along the road frontage. However, clearances from proposed buildings to existing streetlight pole locations are not documented with dimension annotations or setback verification.

details.text: Down guy wires supporting poles may exist given utility poles shown on existing conditions survey and site plan. Specific down guy wire locations (anchor points and cable routing) not explicitly depicted or detailed on plans. No relocation notes or conversion-to-self-supporting-pole specifications provided.

runComments.comment: Down guy wires supporting poles may exist or be implied from the utility poles shown on the existing conditions survey and site plan. However, specific down guy wire locations (anchor points and cable routing) are not explicitly depicted or detailed on the plans. No relocation notes or conversion-to-self-supporting-pole specifications are provided. The grouping guide acknowledges that 'electric utility infrastructure is frequently omitted from plans,' making verification difficult. Applicability cannot be determined without explicit down guy wire depiction.

details.text: Down guy anchor easements (10 feet wide extending 5 feet past ground entry) not explicitly depicted or documented on plat or site plan. Existing utility poles shown on survey may have down guys, but specific anchor locations and dedicated easement boundaries not identified.

runComments.comment: Down guy anchor easements (10 feet wide extending 5 feet past ground entry) are not explicitly depicted or documented on the plat or site plan. Existing utility poles shown on the survey may have down guys, but the specific anchor locations and dedicated easement boundaries are not identified.

comments.headline: Electric easement compliance and ancillary feature clearances unverified
comments.summary: Utility easement boundaries and usage restrictions are not clearly documented. Proposed site features within easements lack verification that facilities are not prohibited and maintain required minimum clearances. Tree species identification and decorative lighting locations are incomplete.
comments.crossDep: Coordinate with Utility company (easement boundaries, facility prohibitions, easement survey); coordinate with Landscape Architecture (tree species selection and utility-compatible plants compliance); coordinate with Architecture (decorative lighting fixture locations).
comments.attn: UCM § 1.10.3 absolutely prohibits customer facilities under or over Austin Energy overhead distribution facilities, independent of clearance distances. Verify easement boundaries against property survey. Landscape plan tree schedule must cross-reference ECM Appendix F Utility Compatible trees list by species name.

details.text: Electric easements (5' and 15' marked on site plan) shown but code prohibits installing customer facilities under or over Austin Energy overhead distribution facilities. Items within easements must maintain minimum 7.5-foot clearance from outside conductor. Without detailed easement boundary documentation and clearance dimension annotations, compliance cannot be verified.

runComments.comment: Electric easements (5' and 15' marked on site plan) are shown on the site plan. The code absolutely prohibits installing customer facilities under or over Austin Energy overhead distribution facilities, independent of clearance distances. Additionally, items within electric easements must maintain minimum 7.5-foot clearance from outside conductor. Without detailed easement boundary documentation and clearance dimension annotations from conductors, compliance cannot be verified.

details.text: Decorative lighting referenced in site plan notes (exterior lighting must be full cut-off and fully-shielded per Subchapter E 2.5, reviewed at building plan stage). Specific decorative lighting fixture locations and their clearances from OHE line not documented with clearance verification dimensions.

runComments.comment: Decorative lighting is referenced in the site plan notes (exterior lighting must be full cut-off and fully-shielded per Subchapter E 2.5, reviewed at building plan stage). However, specific decorative lighting fixture locations and their clearances from the OHE line are not documented with clearance verification dimensions.

details.text: Landscape plan shows trees (existing and mitigation) near OHE line on south property boundary. Lateral distance from tree symbols to conductor line cannot be confirmed as within 10-foot lateral clearance requirement. Tree species identification limited to general categories (SY, PL, P, M) which cannot be cross-referenced against ECM Appendix F Utility Compatible trees list. Utility-compatible species compliance cannot be verified.

runComments.comment: Landscape plan shows trees (existing and mitigation trees) near the OHE line on the south property boundary. However, the lateral distance from specific tree symbols to the OHE conductor line cannot be confirmed as within or outside the 10-foot lateral clearance requirement for distribution conductors. Tree species identification on the landscape plan is limited to general categories (SY=Street Yard, PL=Parking Lot, P=existing trees, M=Mitigation), which cannot be cross-referenced against ECM Appendix F Utility Compatible trees list without detailed plant schedule. Applicability of utility-compatible species restrictions cannot be verified.
